# `Browser.Camera`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.Camera — capture a photo from the device camera (or a
file-input fallback on desktop) as a `data:` URL, over `Ipe.Ffi.Js` ports.

A first-party proof of the per-capability web mechanism: an outbound `JsCmd`
triggers the capture UI, and an inbound `JsMsg` carries the result — a
`PickedFile` record or a typed denial/cancellation. Both cross the same seal
codec and fail-closed port discipline as every other port; there is no second
transport.

On mobile the served JS handler uses an `<input type="file" capture="environment"
accept="image/*">` element, which directs the OS to open the camera. On
desktop it falls back to a plain image file picker. The result shape is
identical in both cases: a `PickedFile` with `name`, `mime`, and `dataUrl`.

Importing this reserved `Ipe.Browser.<Api>` module discloses `js-port:camera`
(import-derived, keyed on the canonical `Ipe.Browser.Camera` path prefix via
`WebCapability::for_browser_module`, alias-immune); only the top-level app's
`[capabilities] accepts` set can grant it.

The two layers:

  * `Ipe.Browser.Camera.Internals` publishes the closed outbound/inbound ADTs
    and the raw `Ipe.Ffi.Js` wiring.
  * this module is the high-level layer: `capturePhoto` returns a
    `Task Error PickedFile` via the correlated port→Task bridge; a user
    cancellation or a host denial resolves to a typed `Err`. The inbound
    `case` is EXHAUSTIVE: every variant becomes either an `Ok` or a typed
    `Err`, never a silently dropped frame.

## `PickedFile`

A captured image: the browser-assigned filename, the image MIME type, and
the full image data encoded as a `data:` URL (e.g. `data:image/jpeg;base64,...`).

## `capturePhoto`

```ipe
capturePhoto : Task Error PickedFile
```

`capturePhoto` — open the camera capture UI (mobile) or an image file
picker (desktop), as a `Task Error PickedFile`.

Uses the correlated port→Task bridge (`Js.request`). The served JS handler
creates a transient `<input type="file" capture="environment" accept="image/*">`
element, reads the selected/captured image via `FileReader.readAsDataURL`,
and resolves the `Task` with the result. A user cancellation resolves to
`Err` (cancelled); a host denial or an absent File API resolves to the
corresponding typed `Err`.

Importing this module discloses `js-port:camera`; the app must grant it with
`accepts = [ JsPort Camera ]` under [capabilities] in package.ipe.

## `captures`

```ipe
captures : (Result Error PickedFile -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`captures toMsg` — the inbound subscription, wired in `subscriptions`.

The decoder IS the security gate: every inbound value runs through the total,
bounded seal decoder for the narrow `JsMsg`; a malformed / mismatched frame
is dropped whole. A decoded `JsMsg` is folded EXHAUSTIVELY into a
`Result Error PickedFile`.
